messages:
maria_cs: quick weekly check-in for Aurora private deployment — want a short region-by-region health snapshot + action items. Observed: sporadic KMS auth failures in eu-west1 (Wed afternoon), latency bump but p99 under our SLO, spend trending +8% MoM. tagging @dan_eng @rachel_sre @sam_se. paste of a sample error we grabbed below

maria_cs: ```
2026-03-12T15:46:02Z aurora-prod eu-west1 hsm-eu-02 KMSAuthError code=503 req_id=6f7a2b
context: token refresh race, client retries 2x then fails
```

dan_eng: looks like token-refresh race to me. can you share full req_id (above ok) and whether we saw a burst of rotate events? also which runtime kernel was serving (quantized v2 or fallback)?

maria_cs: req_id 6f7a2b-0001-4c, happened right after a scheduled key rotation window. runtime was quantized-v2. rotate window: 15:45-15:48 UTC. user impact: ~0.6% of requests in eu-west1 for that 3m window.

rachel_sre: I opened a short incident and toggled fallback KMS key during the spike to stop failures. summary stats this week: eu-west1 uptime 99.2% (small dip Wed), us-central 99.98%, ap-southeast 99.6. p50/p95/p99 latencies: eu-west1 22/85/210 ms (p99 elevated). error-rate spike aligned with rotation window.

ops_bot: [automated] fallback_kms_key enabled for tenant: aurora-prod in eu-west1 at 2026-03-12T15:50:12Z by rachel_sre :white_check_mark:

sam_se: enablement note: onboarding call with Aurora went well. runbook updated with "client retry backoff" snippet and recommended timeouts. scheduled a 45-min training next Wed 10:00 PT to walk through rotate/retry behavior and cost controls. getting customer feedback: they'd like a sample client lib that wraps retries + jitter.

maria_cs: usage trends: last 4 wks tokens/week = 2.1M (up from 1.95M). spend +8% MoM, no immediate renewal risk but flagging for finance review if growth continues. onboarding status: core infra checks done, waiting on two customer tests for DR failover.

dan_eng: I'll ask infra to pull HSM telemetry for hsm-eu-02 and check for certificate overlap during rotate. can we also get KV cache hit rates for eu-west1? if cache hit is low, token churn + cache miss could explain latency + cost bump.

maria_cs: action items: Dan -> infra telemetry + KV hit rates; Rachel -> brief postmortem and rolling mitigations; Sam -> ship sample retry wrapper + runbook snippet to Aurora; Maria -> customer update and schedule finance check if spend growth continues.

rachel_sre: quick note: no wider impact to Dedicated fleet. this looks scoped to that HSM cluster during rotation. will post the short postmortem by EOD. :thumbsup:

maria_cs: thanks all — will ping with updates. next check-in Tue 09:00 PT or sooner if Dan/Rachel find blocker.

sam_se: noted, will prepare the sample code and slide 1-pager for the enablement call.

maria_cs: :sparkles:
